Global options such as `--base-url`, `--tenant` and `--json` go before the command — see [CLI reference](./index.mdx#global-options). Exit codes are listed in [Exit codes](./exit-codes.md).

## apiome tags {#tags}

List, inspect, create and move version tags (named pointers to versions).

```text
apiome tags [OPTIONS] COMMAND [ARGS]...
```

Subcommands: [`create`](#tags-create), [`list`](#tags-list), [`show`](#tags-show), [`update`](#tags-update).

## apiome tags create {#tags-create}

Create a version tag pointing at a version (POST /v1/version-tags/{tenant}/{project}).

Exit 6 when the project already has a tag with that name — move it with `tags update` instead.

```text
apiome tags create [OPTIONS] PROJECT [TAG]
```

**Arguments**

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `PROJECT_REF` | text | yes | Project slug or UUID. |
| `TAG` | text |  | Tag name, lower-cased: a letter, then letters, digits or hyphens (2–41). |

**Options**

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--version` | text |  |  | Version the tag points to: label (2.1.0 or v2.1.0) or revision UUID. |
| `--description` | text |  |  | What the tag is for (stored as its message). |
| `--from-file` | path |  |  | JSON tag object (e.g. an edited `tags show --json`): name, version, description, channel, immutable. |
| `--yes`, `-y` | flag |  |  | Skip the confirmation an immutable tag asks for. |

## apiome tags list {#tags-list}

List a project's version tags and the version each points to (GET /v1/version-tags/{tenant}/{project}).

```text
apiome tags list [OPTIONS] PROJECT
```

**Arguments**

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `PROJECT_REF` | text | yes | Project slug or UUID. |

**Options**

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--limit` | integer range | `50` |  | Show at most this many tags. |
| `--all` | flag |  |  | Show every tag (ignores --limit). |

## apiome tags show {#tags-show}

Show one version tag: the version it points to, its channel, locks and dates.

The server keeps only the current pointer, so no move history is shown.

```text
apiome tags show [OPTIONS] PROJECT TAG
```

**Arguments**

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `PROJECT_REF` | text | yes | Project slug or UUID. |
| `TAG_REF` | text | yes | Tag name (exact) or tag UUID. |

## apiome tags update {#tags-update}

Move a version tag to another version (PATCH /v1/version-tags/{tenant}/{project}/{tag_id}).

Shows where the tag points now and, best-effort, who may be affected — mock requests in the last 7 days, frozen-snapshot downloads and other tags on the current version — then asks to continue.

```text
apiome tags update [OPTIONS] PROJECT TAG
```

**Arguments**

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `PROJECT_REF` | text | yes | Project slug or UUID. |
| `TAG_REF` | text | yes | Tag name (exact) or tag UUID. |

**Options**

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--version` | text |  | yes | Version to move the tag to: label (2.1.0 or v2.1.0) or revision UUID. |
| `--description` | text |  |  | New description (the tag's message); pass '' to clear it. |
| `--dry-run` | flag |  |  | Show the move and its blast radius; change nothing. |
| `--yes`, `-y` | flag |  |  | Skip the confirmation. |
